scientific_integrity.claim_domain: All integers \(m,n\ge1\); labeled rook graphs and the complete inclusion-maximal dissociation-set size distribution.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Line-graph correspondence, \(K_{1,1}\), \(K_{1,2}\), and \(K_{2,1}\) component decomposition, maximal support condition, factorial component enumeration.
scientific_integrity.verification: Standalone exact bitmask enumeration for 17 small graphs and all 1419214 subsets; unlimited case handled by proof.

scientific_limitations: No publication-priority assertion beyond the sources and comparisons actually inspected.
The 2024 grid-graph paper was accessible through its bibliographic abstract, not its complete text.
Finite exhaustive experiments support the mathematical proof but do not prove all parameter values.
title: Maximal dissociation sets of rook graphs: an exact two-star-packing polynomial
